messages:
alex: FYI I noticed a mismatch in the /v1/generate endpoint docs vs SDK snippets. OpenAPI shows query param `model` but the Go + curl examples use `model_id` in the request body. This breaks the live curl quickstart test.

sara: oof. Which files are wrong?

alex: docs/api/generate.md, docs/samples/generate_openapi.json, and snippets/go/generate_example.md. The python snippet is fine.

kevin: probably a fallout from the earlier rename. We intended to normalize to `model` (query/param) across the public API.

lia: quick triage: change the OpenAPI examples to use `model` in the request object, update Go snippet to set `model` in the query string for curl and the SDK request builder, and add a migration note for orgs still using `model_id`.

alex: also the request/response example in generate_openapi.json shows `temperature: "0.2"` (string) in the sample, but our runtime expects a number. docs-lint flagged it as a schema mismatch.

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint error in docs/samples/generate_openapi.json line 18: type mismatch for `temperature` (expected number, got string).

kevin: easy fix: change sample to a numeric value 0.2 and run the schema validator. I'll also add a unit test that validates sample types against the OpenAPI schema so this doesn't regress.

alex: plan: kevin will update sample JSON and Go snippet. lia will update generate.md text to explicitly document: "model (string) - model id or alias; prefer `model` query param. `model_id` is deprecated." Sara will add a short migration note to the top of the page.

sara: I'll draft the migration blurb. Suggest wording: "Migration: if your integration uses `model_id`, switch to `model` in the query string. See SDK notes below."

kevin: I'll push a wip branch `docs/generate-model-param-fix-3740012222` with two commits: `fix-openapi-sample-types` and `sync-go-snippet-model-param`. Linking PR in this thread when ready.

docs-bot: CI: preview build failed: sample validator error fixed locally but lint failed for snippet formatting in snippets/go/generate_example.md line 7: missing fenced codeblock language.

kevin: fixing code fence. Also will add a short Go example showing `q := url.Values{}; q.Set("model", "rwd-small")` so it's explicit.

lia: after merge, we should update the Go SDK changelog and ping SDK owners. Also add a tiny note in the README for self-hosted customers who run older runtime versions (they may still accept `model_id`).

alex: sounds good. Keep the legacy `model_id` mention but mark as deprecated.

kevin: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4891 - contains OpenAPI sample fix, Go snippet tweaks, migration note.

sara: reviewing now. If green I'll merge and regenerate preview.

alex: thanks all. This was causing a failing quickstart test for new users, so high priority.

docs-bot: Deploy preview posted: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/docs/4891. If anything else pops up I will re-run checks.

kevin: merged and added changelog entry: "docs: normalize generate endpoint param to `model`; fix sample types"

lia: verified preview; curl quickstart passes. Closing thread.
